_about: Ground truth for the fish-egg mock communities of Duke & Burton 2020. Nothing here was invented: Table 1 comes from the article, the library key and false positives from its supplementary Table S1.

source.paper: Duke EM, Burton RS (2020) Efficacy of metabarcoding for identification of fish eggs evaluated with mock communities. Ecology and Evolution 10:3463-3476
source.table_1: Table 1 of the article: proportion of eggs of each species in each mock community (eggs counted by hand).
source.table_s1: Supplementary Table S1 (file ECE3-10-3463-s001.docx): per library, the community, primer set, and every species detected that was NOT in the community (false positives) with read counts.
source.data: Zenodo record 4025362 (mirror of Dryad doi:10.5061/dryad.zw3r22854), CC0

markers.COI: Ward et al. 2005 primers, ~710 bp amplicon

source.design: reads were merged pairs; the authors mapped them at 97% similarity to their own local library (Burton_Hastings_COI_16S.fasta)
